Name: Site Acceptance Test (SAT) — per Service Day
Description: Site Acceptance Test (SAT), priced per Service Day: on-site site acceptance testing of a delivered Servomex analyser by a Servomex field engineer, proving it against the agreed acceptance criteria. Quantity is the number of SAT days.

Name: Operator Training — per Service Day
Description: Operator training day, priced per Service Day: on-site operator training by a Servomex trainer covering analyser operation, routine maintenance and troubleshooting. Quantity is the number of operator training days.
